columns.label: Date
columns.formula: Publication date on the source file.

columns.label: WTI
columns.formula: EIA RWTC, dollars per barrel. z is the adjacent log return against the train median and 1.4826 times the train MAD. Train ends 31 Dec 2019.

columns.label: Brent
columns.formula: EIA RBRTE. z uses the same robust scale on Brent's own adjacent log returns.

columns.label: CL1
columns.formula: EIA NYMEX crude futures contract 1. The workbook history ends before the spot series.

columns.label: CL1-CL4
columns.formula: RCLC1 minus RCLC4. Positive means the front is above the fourth. z is a level z-score against the train mean and train population standard deviation.

columns.label: Curve z
columns.formula: (CL1_MINUS_CL4 minus the train mean) divided by the train population standard deviation. Train mean -0.142 dollars per barrel. Train standard deviation 1.850. Both moments stop at 31 Dec 2019 and are applied to every later print. A positive CL1_MINUS_CL4 means the front NYMEX contract is above the fourth.

columns.label: Crack
columns.formula: ((2 * RBOB futures + heating oil futures) / 3) * 42 minus CL1.

columns.label: Crack gap
columns.formula: CRACK_321 minus its train median. Train median 16.739 dollars per barrel. CRACK_321 is ((2 * RBOB_F1 + HO_F1) / 3) * 42 minus RCLC1. A date is absent when any input is absent. The futures workbooks end before the spot series.

columns.label: RV20
columns.formula: Population standard deviation of the last 20 adjacent RWTC log returns, times the square root of 252. A return enters only when the two prints are 1 to 5 calendar days apart. High realized vol is at or above the train 80th percentile, frozen at 0.4535. Implied volatility is not in this archive. No implied-versus-realized ratio is computed.

columns.label: Heat
columns.formula: EIA New York Harbor No. 2 heating oil spot, dollars per gallon.

columns.label: Gasoline
columns.formula: EIA New York Harbor conventional gasoline spot, dollars per gallon.

columns.label: Dollar
columns.formula: FRED broad dollar index, goods and services.
